nom: StriVectin SD Advanced PLUS Intensive Moisturizer

segments.mature: Long-time users, several in their 60s to 80s, credit years of consistent use with visibly younger-looking, firm, even-toned skin, and many say they've used it for decades without switching.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who says her skin normally cracks with most moisturizers, report it absorbs well and relieves tightness through the day.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea or fragrance sensitivity, mostly report no irritation, though the mint scent bothered a couple of them, with one experiencing eye irritation from it.
segments.oily: The reviewers who mention oily skin have mixed experiences: one says it sank in well despite her oily skin, while another found it got heavier and oilier as the day went on.

concerns.aging: The central claim reviewers test; most report visibly softer fine lines and firmer-looking skin within 2-6 weeks, especially on the forehead and around the mouth, though a notable minority say they saw no change to their wrinkles despite consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe it as deeply hydrating without feeling greasy, though several call the texture heavy or slow to absorb, and one found it too rich for summer humidity.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea and hormonal acne reports no irritation and improved skin texture; another notes 'significantly less irritation' after switching to this cream.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers report increased acne as a side effect of regular use, while several others explicitly say it did not cause breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick texture that still absorbs without heaviness
Slight minty fragrance noticeable to some
Considered expensive relative to drugstore options
A little goes a long way, jar lasts months
Results take weeks of consistent use, not instant

extraits.texte: I really wanted to like the StriVectin SD Advanced PLUS Intensive Moisturizer, especially with all the claims about "collagen-boosting peptides" and "Alpha-3 technology. " Unfortunately, after consistent use, this was a total letdown and a complete waste of money. The main issues: No Effect on Wrinkles: Despite the marketing promising visible results in a week, my fine lines and deeper wrinkles haven't changed at all. It feels like a standard, overpriced lotion rather than an "intensive concentrate. " Zero Smoothing: It didn't even improve my skin texture. My face doesn't feel smoother or more refined; if anything, the thick consistency just sits on top of the skin without truly absorbing. Overpriced: For the high price tag, you expect more than just basic hydration. You can get the same moisturizing effect from a drugstore brand for a fraction of the cost.

extraits.titre: Greasy, overly scented, and no noticeable change
extraits.texte: Unfortunately I didn't notice any change while using this on my face, or on stretch marks in an area I couldn't photograph. The menthol scent was overwhelming and all I could smell all day, and it felt very greasy. It went on evenly, and the little bottle was cute and easy to use without it spitting out far too much. I won't be continuing to use this.

extraits.titre: Works well, got some acne though
extraits.texte: I have used this brand before and enjoyed- this product is such a nice size you don't mind using it twice a day. I cut this close to the date to use a full 30 days. I noticed softening of my forehead lines but also increased acne. I don't mind having that to get some softer wrinkles but can't use this as a staple more a treatment. I'd like to try once every other day and see if it still helps me without breaking me out. I started this on my neck and do see improvement as well. I would love an acne sensitive StriVectin line! The packaging and quality is always top notch and like I said this has a great size for your stretch marks or face will go a long way.

extraits.titre: Will continue to use this moisturizer.
extraits.texte: Absolutely loved this product. It is creamy and gentle. It is not greasy and it smells amazing. I have very sensitive skin and it is not irritating at all. I have noticed improved smoothness and significantly less irritation now that I'm using it. It absorbs quickly and my makeup goes on well over it.

extraits.titre: Really lives up to the hype!
extraits.texte: I was so excited to try this product after hearing such great things about the brand. I'm almost 47, and the fine lines and wrinkles are certainly broadcasting my age effectively. I don't mind getting older (even if I feel like I'm still young) but still want to take care of my skin so I can age gracefully as much as possible. First off, this lotion is super moisturizing and absorbs well into the skin. It can be worn day or night depending on your skin care routine. The lotion has no irritating scent and it worked really well with my sensitive skin (rosacea and hormonal acne outbreak, ugh!) This has been a fantastic addition to my skin care routine, it has really helped improve my skin texture but also helped reduce the appearance of fine lines. I'm eager to continue using this as a permanent fixture of my skin care routine!

I have extremely dry skin. Not just having a "tight feeling" on my face- my skin is so dry that it cracks and many moisturizers will just pill up instead of absorbing into my skin. This one absorbs and staves off the tight feeling for the entire day. A little goes a long way too; I've been using it for a month and haven't even used half of the product yet. Once I apply it the lines on my face smooth out and it looks firmer.

StriVectin SD Advance PLUS Intensive Moisturizer is one product I didn't even know I needed. It is so good to my skin and doesn't cause breakouts. It contains collagen with boosting peptides power, Elastin, Hyaluronic Acid helping skin look visibly plump, less visible lines, wrinkles and even helps on stretch marks. No wonder it is the number one selling stretch mark cream.
